name: Buon Giardino Produce
description: A small farm in Lockeford, CA, Buon Giardino Produce grows Cherries, Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, and Green beans. The farm is busiest in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jun in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
